pages.text: An engine sets your automobile's $(bold)Torque$() and $(bold)Speed$(). Higher tiers accelerate harder and reach a higher top speed.

pages.title: Engine Tiers
pages.text: Crafted in the Auto Mechanic Table, under the Engines category, from progressively better materials:$(br)Stone → Copper → Iron → Gold → Diamond$(br)A Creative engine is also available for testing builds.
